name: Joy Division

whyMatters.en: Punk energy pressed into cold bass and empty air—Post-Punk and Indie inherit a mood and a rhythm grammar that still feels like night.
whyMatters.zh: 把 Punk 的能量压进冰冷低音与空房间——Post-Punk 与 Indie 继承一种至今仍像夜晚的情绪与节奏语法。

note.zh: Post-Punk 进入大众记忆的单曲

interviewQuotes.text: I used to think of myself as an artist.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Ian Curtis

lyricQuotes: Love will tear us apart again

shortBio.en: Decisive template for Post-Punk mood and bass lines.
shortBio.zh: Post-Punk 情绪与低音线的决定性模板。

body.en:
Joy Division take punk's urgency and refrigerate it. Hooky's bass leads, Sumner's guitar scratches at the walls, Curtis sings like the floor might open.

The template for Post-Punk mood is locked before the decade turns.
body.zh:
Joy Division 把朋克的紧迫放进冷藏。Hooky 的贝斯领路，Sumner 的吉他刮墙，Curtis 唱得像地板可能裂开。

Post-Punk 情绪模板在十年翻页前就锁死了。

body.en:
Punk breaks the furniture. Joy Division rearranges what is left into negative space. Bass becomes melody; drums become machinery; emotion arrives as frost.

Indie later borrows the coat. Few fill it the same way.
body.zh:
Punk 砸家具。Joy Division 把剩下的排成负空间。贝斯变主旋律，鼓变机器，情绪以霜的形式到场。

后来 Indie 借这件外套。很少有人穿出同样的样子。

body.en:
Dance, dance, dance to the radio—an order delivered from a great emotional distance. Transmission makes movement feel like discipline and release at once.

Post-Punk learns it can be physical without becoming cheerful.
body.zh:
Dance, dance, dance to the radio——命令从很远的情感距离送达。Transmission 让移动同时像纪律与释放。

Post-Punk 学会可以身体性，而不必变得欢快。

title.en: Love Will Tear Us Apart: the public scar
title.zh: Love Will Tear Us Apart：公开的伤疤

body.en:
The single that carries Post-Punk into common memory. Melody almost kind; lyric not kind at all.

After this, cold music can chart. The contradiction becomes a genre habit.
body.zh:
把 Post-Punk 带进大众记忆的单曲。旋律近乎温柔；歌词一点也不。

在此之后，冷的音乐也能上榜。矛盾变成流派习惯。

title.en: Bass lines that taught a generation to walk
title.zh: 教会一代人走路的低音线

body.en:
From Factory Records afterglow to countless Indie bassists who lead with the left hand, Joy Division sit upstream of mood rock.

Punk's children learn restraint here—and never quite warm up again.
body.zh:
从 Factory 余烬到无数用左手领路的 Indie 贝斯手，Joy Division 坐在情绪摇滚上游。

Punk 的孩子们在这里学会克制——并且再也没真正暖和回来。

body.en:
Curtis's lines and the band's sparse talk leave more shadow than explanation. The quotes work because they refuse therapy language.

Nail them lightly. The music already said the heavy part.
body.zh:
Curtis 的句子与乐队稀少的谈话留下影子多于解释。金句有效，因为它们拒绝疗愈腔。

轻轻钉上。重的部分音乐已经说完。

note.en: Space, bass, and restraint become a whole aesthetic.
note.zh: 空间、贝斯与克制自成美学。
